name: Kubernetes connectivity check
description: Audit pod VIPs, OSPF adjacencies and 5G network connectivity

phase.description: Checklist phase: vip, ospf, ping or all

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace containing the target pods

ip_ausf.description: Remote AUSF IPv4 list, separated by commas or spaces

ip_udm.description: Remote UDM IPv4 list, separated by commas or spaces

ip_smf.description: Remote SMF IPv4 list, separated by commas or spaces

ip_amf_remote.description: Remote AMF IPv4 list, separated by commas or spaces

ip_nrf.description: Remote NRF IPv4 list, separated by commas or spaces

ip_gnodeb.description: gNodeB IPv4 list, separated by commas or spaces
